description: Shared views for Hypercerts API read models.

profileView.description: Profile record view preserving the full indexed record; indexedAt may be null when the index has no timestamp.

organizationView.description: Raw organization sidecar record view preserving the full indexed record; indexedAt may be null when the index has no timestamp.

locationRecordView.description: Raw indexed location record view without a hydrated author; indexedAt may be null when the index has no timestamp.

actorView.description: Actor DID with nullable indexed profile and organization sidecars. Direct actor and organization queries also return a nullable primary location. Records retain raw blobs and URI references, not resolved image URLs.

handle.description: Resolved handle, populated only by getActor when a best-effort lookup succeeds. Omitted by every other endpoint; null is accepted for older responses.

location.description: Raw primary location, or null when no valid primary location is indexed. Matched by AT-URI, not the pinned CID; the indexed version may differ. Additional locations stay as strong references in the organization record. Omitted in legacy author views.

acknowledgementView.description: Acknowledgement record with its publisher actor.
